_module.description: Physics threading model configuration -- controls physics thread priority, CPU affinity, queue capacity, and Jolt JobSystem parameters. Fields listed in requires_restart need a physics thread restart to take effect.

_comment.threadPriority: Physics thread priority, string, "low"|"normal"|"high", default "high", physics simulation is latency-sensitive so high is recommended
_comment.affinityMask: CPU affinity mask, uint64, 0 means OS-scheduled, default 0, non-zero binds the physics thread to specific cores
_comment.commandQueueSize: Command queue capacity, int, >0, default 256, SPSC lock-free queue pre-allocated capacity
_comment.resultQueueSize: Result queue capacity, int, >0, default 64, SPSC lock-free queue pre-allocated capacity
_comment.maxPendingFrames: Max pending frames, int, >0, default 3, oldest frame is dropped when exceeded to prevent frame buildup [D23]
_comment.jobSystemMaxJobs: Jolt JobSystem maxJobs, int, >0, default 2048, corresponds to JobSystemThreadPool constructor parameter
_comment.jobSystemMaxBarriers: Jolt JobSystem maxBarriers, int, [1,8], default 8, Jolt internal limit cMaxPhysicsBarriers=8, corresponds to JobSystemThreadPool constructor parameter
_comment.jobSystemThreadCount: Jolt JobSystem thread count, int, -1=auto(CPU cores-1), default -1, number of extra worker threads when physics has its own thread

_restart_note: Fields listed in requires_restart need a physics thread restart to take effect
